content: I want to add some lemmas about symmetric differences (of sets) and here's my PR: #38536. I add these lemmas in the file ‎Mathlib.Data.Set.SymmDiff (which I think is the most natural place to put them), and my PR cannot pass the CI because some of the lemmas I want to add use Set.iUnion, which is not allowed to be imported in Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Pointwise.Set.Scalar (which imports ‎Mathlib.Data.Set.SymmDiff). I have also considered Mathlib.Data.Set.Lattice but that file is pretty long (and also it doesn't seem like a good fit). Any suggestions on how I should resolve this issue?

Snir Broshi said:

file#Mathlib/Data/Set/Lattice works, or a new file

What if in the future I want to include more lemmas about how symmetric differences interact with other Set.notations? This is the main reason I don't want to add these new lemmas into Mathlib.Data.Set.Lattice as it is already pretty long.

Not sure about whether I should create a new file.
